buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Deputy Collector Civil Station Agatti Island U.T. of Lakshadweep Pin 682553 . 3. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning The scope of work under this bid shall be on a complete "Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning ( SITC)" basis. The successful bidder shall be responsible for supplying, transporting, unloading, installing, t esting and commissioning the Diesel Generator (DG) Set along with all accessories, fittings and ancillary it ems required for satisfactory operation of the DG Set, at Civil Station, at Agatti Island in U.T. of Lakshadwe ep. The bidder shall provide and install all materials and components necessary for successful commissioning of the DG Set, whether specifically mentioned in the bid document or otherwise required for completing th e work in all respects. This shall include, but not be limited to: 1. Power and control cables of suitable size, cable glands, cable lugs, cable trays/supports, conduit pipes a nd associated accessories. 2. Earthing materials, earthing conductors, earth pits (where required), and all associated accessories as p er applicable standards. 3. Foundation/base platform, PCC/RCC foundation, anti-vibration pads, grouting, floor preparation and all ci vil works required for safe installation of the DG Set. 4. Fuel system accessories, silencer arrangements, and other accessories required for proper functioning o f the DG Set. 5. Interconnection works between the DG Set, AMF/ATS panel (where applicable), existing electrical syste m and load point.

6. All fasteners, tools, fixtures and miscellaneous items required for installation, testing and commissionin g. 7 Any other equipment, material, component or accessory required for making the DG Set fully functional and ready for operation at site. 8. For any clarification regarding the site conditions, bidders may contact the concerned site representativ e at 9495079485 during working hours The DG Set shall be handed over in complete working condition after successful testing, commissioning an d demonstration to the satisfaction of the Purchaser. .
